title: Avoid `as const` on mutable request payloads
description: Builds a request body and later mutates it.
code:
const payload = { status: 'draft' } as const;
payload.status = 'published';
issue_title: Literal assertion freezes a value that is later mutated
issue_description: The type now claims the field is immutable and one exact literal, which conflicts with later updates.
issue_suggestion: Use a normal typed object when the value is meant to change.

title: Prefer typed response parsing over double assertion
description: Casts a parsed API payload through unknown and into a final type.
code: const user = (await response.json()) as unknown as User;
issue_description: Casting through unknown suppresses the compiler without proving the payload matches the expected shape.
issue_suggestion: Validate the payload or narrow it with a parser before use.

title: Model dictionary lookups as possibly undefined
description: Reads from a record and uses the result as if it always exists.
code:
const names: Record<string, string> = {};
return names[userId].toUpperCase();
issue_title: Record access can still return undefined at runtime
issue_description: The object may not contain the requested key even though the value type is string.
issue_suggestion: Handle the missing case explicitly before dereferencing the value.

title: Do not erase event target type with `Event`
description: Types an input change handler with the base DOM Event type.
issue_title: Base Event type is too weak for the handler usage
issue_description: The generic Event target does not guarantee a value property.
issue_suggestion: Use the specific React or DOM event type for the control.

title: Keep branded identifiers distinct
description: Uses plain strings for both user ids and order ids.
code:
type UserId = string;
type OrderId = string;
issue_description: Plain aliases do not stop accidental mixing of unrelated ids.
issue_suggestion: Use branded types when distinct ids should not be assignable to each other.

title: Do not return `Promise<void>` from data loaders that produce data
description: Types a fetch helper as void while returning JSON.
issue_description: Callers cannot use the result safely because the declared contract says there is no value.
issue_suggestion: Declare the actual resolved type of the async function.

title: Prefer exhaustive switches on discriminated unions
description: Handles only some variants of a result union.
issue_title: One union branch is silently unhandled
issue_description: Adding or forgetting a variant can leave the function returning undefined unexpectedly.
issue_suggestion: Make the switch exhaustive and force the compiler to check every branch.

title: Avoid optional chaining when absence should be impossible
description: Silently returns undefined for a required configuration value.
issue_title: A required invariant is treated as optional
issue_description: Optional chaining can hide configuration problems that should fail fast.
issue_suggestion: Validate required configuration explicitly and keep the type non-optional.

title: Keep mapped types aligned with runtime shape
description: Builds a partial update object but types it as the full entity.
code:
type User = { id: string; email: string; name: string };
const patch: User = { email: 'a@example.com' };
issue_title: Type claims required fields that are not present
issue_description: A partial update payload should not be typed as the full resource shape.
issue_suggestion: Use Partial or a dedicated patch type for partial updates.

title: Type tuple return values explicitly when positions matter
description: Returns a two-value array from a hook without a tuple annotation.
issue_description: Without a tuple type, callers get a broad array type instead of a fixed pair contract.
issue_suggestion: Annotate the return value as a tuple.
